description: Compress a JPEG, PNG or WebP to a smaller file, choosing quality or a target size. AVIF, HEIC, TIFF and BMP are browser-only and not accepted here. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/image-compressor (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The image file as base64, in the format given by type. Send the whole file as it is, up to 50 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/image-compressor (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

format.description: The output format. 'auto' always means WebP, which is usually the smallest. If the result would be no smaller than the input at the same size, the original bytes are returned unchanged.

maxEdge.description: Shrink the image so its longer side is at most this many pixels, keeping the aspect ratio. Smaller images are left at their size; omit it to keep the dimensions.

name.description: The source filename, echoed back as the result's name.

quality.description: Encoder quality from 0.1 to 1 for JPEG and WebP output; lower means a smaller, softer file. PNG is lossless and ignores it.

type.description: The MIME type of the source image: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp. HEIC, AVIF, TIFF and BMP are not accepted over the API.

name: image_compressor
title: Image Compressor
